composition_subtypes.role: Preprocess by sorting each duration group by departure day
Efficiently scan and maintain min cost for complementary durations

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort vouchers by duration and departure, then two-pointer scan to minimize cost of non-overlapping pairs with exact total duration.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables efficient two-pointer matching across duration groups; two-pointer greedily tracks minimum cost as constraints move monotonically.
